#Workstr programs are plain NIP-101e workout templates — kind:33402, addressable via d = workstr:program:<slug>.
 
The prescription is one exercise tag per set, referencing a kind:33401 exercise by coordinate:
["exercise", "33401:<pubkey>:<d>", "<relay>", weight, reps, rpe, set_type] (timed work swaps that for duration + set_type). 

Plus t tags for discovery and an imeta muscle map. Workstr-only fields — rest, notes, order — sit in a namespaced workstr_meta tag everyone else ignores, so the event stays readable to any NIP-101e client while my re-import stays lossless.

Publishing a program publishes its exercises first. No dangling references. 

It is good to note that importing a Program will automatically import the exercises in it.

以下是基于玄学逻辑的2026年A股“天机”推演：

🌌 核心定调：丙午“赤马”之劫与火运巅峰
2026年是农历丙午年。

天干：丙（属阳火，为太阳之火，猛烈、普照）。
地支：午（属阳火，为仲夏极热之时）。
纳音：天河火。
大势研判：烈火烹油，暴涨暴跌
在五行逻辑中，丙午年是**“火上加火”，且处于“三元九运”中九紫离火运**的第三年。火势在这一年达到极致。

象义：这匹“赤马”性情极其暴烈。对应到股市，意味着极端的波动率。市场情绪会极度亢奋（丙火主礼、主虚荣、主扩散），但也极易失控。
结论：2026年的A股绝不是温吞水，而是一场**“过山车”**。要么是史诗级的“疯牛”（火势冲天），要么是快速的崩塌（火尽灰冷），中间几乎没有横盘震荡的空间。

🔮 卦象推演：离为火（䷝）
2026年的年卦主象为**“离为火”**（六冲卦）。

卦辞：“利贞，亨。畜牝牛，吉。”
解读：
外实内虚：火的形态是外焰明亮，内部空心。这预示着2026年的A股指数可能非常好看（外实），但个股分化极其惨烈，或者基本面（内）其实支撑不住高估值，全靠一口“气”吊着。
依附关系：离卦讲究“依附”。火必须附着在燃烧物上。这意味着市场行情高度依赖**“政策”或“题材”**这根木头。一旦题材烧完，火瞬间熄灭。
六冲之象：六冲代表冲散、快速。这再次印证了**“快进快出”**的特征。长线持股在这一年可能极其煎熬，短线投机将盛行。

⚔️ 五行板块决战：火金相战
在丙午年，五行气场的最大特征是**“火旺克金”**。

1. 当红炸子鸡：火属性行业（大吉）
九紫离火叠加丙午流年，火势通天。

行业：人工智能（AI）、半导体、军工航天、能源（光伏/核能）、文化传媒、虚拟现实。
推演：科技股（特别是硬科技）将在2026年迎来泡沫化的巅峰。估值会被炒到天上去，因为“丙火”主光明、主幻象。凡是“看不见摸不着”的概念，都会被爆炒。
2. 受难者：金属性行业（大凶）
强火熔金，金气受损。

行业：银行、传统金融、重工业、机械制造、有色金属（非锂电类）。
推演：金融体系可能面临巨大的压力（火克金）。这可能通过**“货币制度改革”、“银行坏账暴露”或者“金融监管风暴”**体现出来。传统蓝筹股在这一年可能表现疲软，甚至成为指数的拖累。
3. 绝处逢生：土属性行业（中平/转折）
火生土，但火多土焦。

行业：房地产、基建。
推演：房地产在经历之前的寒冬后，在2026年可能会有一种**“回光返照”或“焦土重生”**的迹象。不是因为基本面好了，而是因为通胀（火）把资产价格名义上推高了。

春季（寅卯月，木生火）：疯牛启动
时间：2月-4月。
剧情：木生火，燃料充足。春节后市场可能会有一波极为凶猛的主升浪，科技股带头冲锋，指数逼空，散户跑步入场。
夏季（巳午未月，火旺极）：见顶与闪崩
时间：5月-7月。
剧情：火势到达顶峰（午月见午，自刑）。市场情绪达到癫狂，随后可能发生**“熔断式”的暴跌**。这是“阳极必阴”的时刻，必须在端午前后极度警惕。
秋季（申酉月，火克金）：惨烈博弈
时间：8月-10月。
剧情：金气进场，与火交战。政策（金）试图降温或救市，市场剧烈震荡，多空双杀。
冬季（亥子月，水克火）：一地鸡毛还是水火既济？
时间：11月-次年1月。
剧情：水来灭火。如果之前跌透了，这里会有反弹（水火既济）；如果之前还在高位，这里就是彻底的冷却（火灭）。

“赤马奔腾路不平，神仙难断午时阴。”

GM ☀️🦉

I was fortunate to be able to see the free world premiere outdoor screening of Wild Inside with Q&A from the director last night. This finally brought the whole Flaco story around full circle for me.

Like so many of my neighbors in early 2023, I was completely captivated by the seemingly impossible story of an escaped zoo owl finding a new home in Central Park, what Manhattanites collectively refer to as their back yard.

I had a chance to see him myself and capture a few pictures when he was perched in one of his favorite trees in the wooded area in the northernmost section of the park. After he died, we went to his memorial at the base of another one of his favorite trees.

This is a story about survival, but also about the fragility of life and nature, and the role we as humans play in it. If you have a chance to see the film, I highly recommend it. It’s opening tomorrow at IFC Center. and in wider release starting on Tuesday.

I have been monitoring the situation for some time.

At the start of lockdown, a former holiday camp entertainer pivoted to doing walking videos, that has grown to become his full time job and has allowed him to buy his dream home for cash. This is him:
https://www.youtube.com/@WalkWithMeTim

More recently our local homeless man in Ventnor has started a YouTube channel and is now earning around $20 a day from 7,000 followers. This is him:
https://www.youtube.com/@Cornishvandweller

The most notable YouTuber I follow is Bald and Bankrupt, who, despite breaking all the rules has grown his channel to 4.5M subscribers here:
https://www.youtube.com/@baldandbankrupt

At the same time, the local Witchcraft shop in Ventnor is closing due to lack of demand. Believe it or not, there was a competing Witchcraft shop that closed a while ago. They didn't have the staying power of the original.

So my observations tell me to be authentic, understand your niche, if it isn't too niche, then do the work and grow your audience. It takes time and effort and you have to love it, so that the pain and hard work required don't incentivise you to quit. 

Another useful lesson, is that WalkWithMeTim's real passion is the local walks he started doing in his home town. There wasn't the large scale audience for that, so he observed his audiences preferences and evolved to be the travel review channel he is now. Despite this, he still runs a smaller walking channel which is his first love here:
https://www.youtube.com/@coastaladventureswithtim/videos

These are all second hand observations, so feel free to dismiss them. I earn about 500 Sats a month from NOSTR 😂
